-- deferred: SVI tail lemmas re-derived as corollaries of the general lemma; left-wing bound: IsNormalizedCallPrice (bsSmile p) implies b(1 - rho) ≤ 2, and the mass at zero; calendar-spread martingale step for any convex payoff via conditional Jensen; t > 0 calendar statements tied to the local-variance characterisation; unification of blackForm, totalVarianceCall and logBlackCall into one (k, w) Black form; IsNormalizedCallPrice from a nonnegative random variable with mean 1 (easy direction); port hygiene: scoped maxHeartbeats, maxRecDepth and open scoped Classical
-- blueprint: thm:smile-no-arbitrage






/-- For any everywhere-positive total variance `w`, the Black form `blackForm k (w k)` tends to
`0` as `k → +∞` iff `dpl k (w k)` tends to `-∞`. -/

-- apply: MathFin.SVI.blackCall_le_Phi_dpl, MathFin.SVI.bsSmile_nonneg
theorem blackForm_nonneg_le_Phi_dpl (k w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w) : 0 ≤ MathFin.ForwardSmile.blackForm k w ∧ MathFin.ForwardSmile.blackForm k w ≤ MathFin.Phi (MathFin.ForwardSmile.dpl k w) := by sorry

end MathFin

/-- **The `(k, w)` unfolding**: at zero rates with `K = F·e^k`, the `bsV`
composite on the tilted surface is the forward-normalized Black form at the
total variance `w = σ_BS²·T`. -/
theorem bsCallSmile_eq {F σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T : ℝ} (hF : 0 < F) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hst : 0 < smileSurface σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T) :
    bsCallSmile F σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T = F * blackForm k (totalVar σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T) := by
  have hne : smileSurface σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T * Real.sqrt T ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero hst.ne' (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hT).ne'
  have hsplit : Real.sqrt (smileSurface σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T ^ 2 * T)
      = smileSurface σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T * Real.sqrt T := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _) T, Real.sqrt_sq hst.le]
  have hbsd1 : bsd1 F (F * Real.exp k) 0 (smileSurface σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T) T
      = dpl k (totalVar σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T) := bsd1_eq_dpl hF.ne' hst hT
  have hbsd2 : bsd2 F (F * Real.exp k) 0 (smileSurface σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T) T
      = dmi k (totalVar σ ψ₁ T₀ ε k T) := by
    unfold bsd2
    rw [hbsd1]
    unfold dmi dpl totalVar
    rw [hsplit]
    field_simp [hne]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt hT.le]
    ring
  unfold bsCallSmile bsV blackForm
  rw [hbsd1, hbsd2]
  norm_num [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_zero]
  ring

/-- `∂_k σ_BS = ε·ψ₁/√(T+T₀)` — the surface is affine in `k`. -/
private theorem hasDerivAt_smileSurface_k {σ ψ₁ T₀ ε T x : ℝ} :
    HasDerivAt (fun y ↦ smileSurface σ ψ₁ T₀ ε y T) (ε * ψ₁ / Real.sqrt (T + T₀)) x := by
  have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ ↦ σ + (ε * ψ₁ / Real.sqrt (T + T₀)) * y)
      (ε * ψ₁ / Real.sqrt (T + T₀)) x := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul (ε * ψ₁ / Real.sqrt (T + T₀))).add_const σ
  refine h0.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
  filter_upwards with y
  unfold smileSurface
  field_simp

open ForwardSmile (dpl dmi blackForm bsd1_eq_dpl)

/-- The SVI-smiled Black–Scholes price in MathFin's existing price API,
with spot, maturity and discount factor normalized to one. -/
noncomputable def bsSmile (p : Params) (K : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  MathFin.bsV K 0 (rootVariance p (Real.log K)) 1 1

theorem blackCall_eq_bsSmile (p : Params) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hw : 0 < variance p (Real.log K)) : blackCall p K = bsSmile p K := by
  have hn := ne_of_gt (rootVariance_pos p (Real.log K) hw)
  have hd1 : MathFin.bsd1 1 K 0 (rootVariance p (Real.log K)) 1 =
      dpl (Real.log K) (variance p (Real.log K)) := by
    have h := bsd1_eq_dpl (F := 1) (k := Real.log K) one_ne_zero (rootVariance_pos p _ hw) one_pos
    rwa [one_mul, Real.exp_log hK, mul_one, rootVariance_sq p _ hw.le] at h
  have hd2 : MathFin.bsd2 1 K 0 (rootVariance p (Real.log K)) 1 =
      dmi (Real.log K) (variance p (Real.log K)) := by
    rw [MathFin.bsd2, hd1]
    simp only [Real.sqrt_one, mul_one, dpl_eq_rootVariance, dmi_eq_rootVariance]
    ring
  simp [blackCall, ForwardSmile.blackForm, bsSmile, MathFin.bsV, hd1, hd2, Real.exp_log hK]

/-- The certificate applies to the existing Black–Scholes function with SVI
volatility substituted strike by strike, not a constant-volatility derivative. -/
theorem bsSmile_convex_iff (p : Params) (hs : 0 < p.sigma)
    (hw : ∀ k : ℝ, 0 < variance p k) :
